findings.explanation: The diff replaces parameterized queries (using %s placeholders) with string formatting (using .format()). This allows user-controlled inputs (db_name, db_user, db_username, db_pwd) to be injected directly into the SQL command string, enabling SQL injection attacks.

findings.suggested_fix: Revert to using parameterized queries with %s placeholders for all user-controlled values. For identifiers (like usernames and database names) that cannot be parameterized, use psycopg2.sql.Identifier to safely quote them, or implement strict allowlisting/validation of the input format.
